action_replace.message: replace the job here, keep its history

add_from_tab.message: Take the invitation from the current tab

add_page.message: Add the current page as a job

add_service_text.message: Open an invitation link of the service in a tab, or “Add to the browser extension” under “My devices” of its web application, and press this button while that tab is shown. The extension asks for permission to reach that service only.

add_title.message: Add a service or a local store

case_known.message: Differs from here; choose per field.

case_old_address.message: Here under the new address $1; choose per field.

contract_blocks.message: This service speaks another version of the interface; closing runs and reading files in stay locked until the older side is updated.

contract_mismatch.message: $1 speaks version $2 of the interface, this extension $3. Update the one that is older.

copy_refused.message: The browser did not allow copying.

err_access_gone.message: This extension's access to the service was revoked or the person deactivated. Remove the service and add it again with a new link.

err_busy.message: The store is being changed in another window. Try again in a moment.

err_deactivated.message: The person this invitation is for is deactivated on the service.

err_locked.message: The store of this extension is locked.

err_unreachable.message: The service cannot be reached. Is it running, and does this computer trust its certificate? Chrome and Edge need the service's certificate authority imported as a trusted root.

err_vault_exists.message: Another window has created the local store meanwhile.

exchange_text.message: The file holds every job with its login, its history and the deleted jobs. Every Portal-Download service and this extension read it in.

export_reminder.message: Export the jobs of this browser now and then: a forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered.

ext_description.message: The due portal downloads of every Portal-Download service, and of a store in this browser, in the side panel.

file_password.message: Password for the file (8 to 200 characters: letters A–Z, digits, punctuation)

file_password_in.message: Password of the file, if it has one

file_too_large.message: The file is larger than 48 MB; that is no exchange file.

forgot_button.message: Delete the store and the services

forgot_text.message: The passphrase cannot be recovered. You can only delete the local store with its jobs and the services kept with it, and add the services again with new links. Their accesses stay valid on the services: revoke them there under “My devices”.

imported.message: Read in – added: $1, updated: $2, brought back: $3, replaced: $4, left out: $5, runs added: $6.

language_discard.message: Changing the language reloads the panel; what you typed or the file preview will be lost. Continue?

local_remove_text.message: Deletes the local store with its jobs; the services stay, and their tokens lie unencrypted again. Export the jobs first.

local_text.message: A store of jobs in this browser only, encrypted with a passphrase. Once it exists, the tokens of the services lie under the passphrase too, and the extension asks for it after every start of the browser.

login_hidden.message: This backend shows no logins to this device.

login_local.message: The login is kept in this browser, encrypted with the passphrase.

login_plain.message: The login is kept in plain text, visible to everybody who uses this backend.

no_invitation.message: The current tab shows no invitation link of a Portal-Download service.

not_encrypted.message: The file came back unencrypted; nothing was saved.

open_portal.message: Open the portal in a new tab

passphrase_changed.message: The passphrase is changed. Use the new one from now on.

passphrase_short.message: The passphrase needs at least 10 characters.

passphrase_warning.message: A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered: the jobs of this browser are then lost, unless you exported them. Export them now and then.

password_needed.message: Enter a password, or download without one.

people_left_out.message: The file is a full backup: this store reads its jobs only, not its people, devices and tokens.

permission_refused.message: Without the permission the extension cannot reach the service.

preselected_hint.message: The newer side of each field is chosen, for a due date the nearer one; change what you want, then read in.

preview_title.message: What reading the file in does

remove_service_text.message: Removes the service from this extension and revokes this extension's access there.

revoke_failed.message: The access there could not be revoked; revoke it in the service's web application under “My devices”.

signed_out.message: $1: this extension's access is no longer valid. Remove the service and add it again with a new link.

unlock_text.message: Enter the passphrase of this extension's store.

url_hint.message: A new address makes this a new job for the exchange; its history stays.

webapp_text.message: People, devices, agents and the full backup of this service are managed in its web application.

welcome_text.message: Add a Portal-Download service with an invitation link, or keep jobs in this browser only.

err_damaged.message: The passphrase fits, but the store cannot be read; it is damaged. Delete it under “Forgot the passphrase?”, create a new local store, import your last export of the jobs, and add your services again with new invitation links.

docs_count.message: $1 found, highlighted in yellow and numbered in the page. Untick what is no document; click a name to scroll to it. Documents downloaded before are unticked.

docs_none.message: Nothing found that looks like a document.

docs_no_page.message: Open the portal page in the active tab first.

docs_refused.message: Without access to this page the extension cannot search it.

docs_refused_downloads.message: Without the permission to download, the extension can only highlight.

docs_folder.message: Saved into $1 in your download folder.

docs_stopping.message: Stops now; a download under way may still finish.

docs_err_navigated.message: the page went to another address; the rest is stopped

docs_err_tab.message: it opened a tab without a document

docs_err_timeout.message: still not finished after five minutes

docs_http.message: This page is not on https. The extension searches only https pages, and http pages on this computer.

docs_folder_firefox.message: Links are normally saved into $1 in your download folder; documents from buttons straight into your download folder.

docs_err_html.message: a web page came back instead of a document, perhaps because the login expired; it was deleted

docs_err_gone.message: the element is no longer in the page; search again

docs_err_container.message: the tab is a container tab: Firefox lets the extension download links only with the normal cookies; open the portal in a normal tab

docs_err_stopped.message: stopped; the browser may still finish this download

docs_unsure.message: Not ticked: it may not be a download. Tick it if it is.

docs_hidden.message: $1 more left out, because their words or address name an action such as delete, log out or upload.

watch_offer.message: Something missing or wrong? Show me how you download

watch_intro.message: Download one document in the page the way you normally do; if the button you use is the one the extension missed, click it anyway. The extension notes your clicks and makes a text of them, in English, that you can post as feedback.

watch_what_tab.message: Watched are this tab, its frames, the pages it loads, and a tab opened from it right after a click. It ends at the first download, after two minutes, or when you stop it, close the tab or leave this view.

watch_what_click.message: Noted for each click: what kind of element it was, its words, a few yes-or-no marks such as "opens a new tab", and what the search made of it; then a new page or tab, and the download as kind and size. No addresses, file names, ids or scripts, and never what you typed or chose in a field.

watch_what_private.message: In the words, digits become # and e-mail addresses [e-mail]; a name cannot be recognised. Nothing is sent: you see the text, can change it, and decide whether to copy it.

watch_refused.message: Without access to this site and to the downloads, nothing can be watched.

watch_now.message: Now download one document in the page, as you always do.

watch_end_download.message: A download started; watching has ended.

watch_end_timeout.message: No download within two minutes; watching has ended.

watch_end_gone.message: The tab was closed; watching has ended.

watch_check.message: Read the text; it holds the last five clicks, and you can change it in the box. Set the tick below first, as it makes the text anew; then delete anything personal from the words in quotes.

watch_blind.message: This page cannot be watched: the extension cannot get into it (a page of the browser itself, or a site it has no access to).
